<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_SalesOrder" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/sales-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteApproval" name="Quote approved by customer"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SalesOrder" name="Sales Order Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Customer inquiry received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect information and address concerns">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInterested</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproval" name="Customer approves quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_QuoteApproval" messageRef="Message_QuoteApproval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Gateway_Interested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Customer is interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproval" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
